subtitle: Cross the four Regions of Vale, hunt the dragon, and earn the name of Ether Mage.

dragons.grimroch: Its scales are stone and the water behind them deep; it turns spells aside and is seldom slower than you.
dragons.helsang: It surges back from every wound, Shadow carrying it from the hunt to the kill and back without warning.
dragons.rodving: Slow to rise and thin of hide, but its fire is the last breath most mages ever draw.
dragons.vuurhast: It comes out of the dark on the storm, already moving, gone before the thunder.
